detailsSections.heading: Overview
detailsSections.text: Sobha Crescent is a premium ultra-luxury residential project located on Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram. Developed by Sobha Limited, it offers beautifully designed 3 & 4 BHK residences with world-class construction quality and modern lifestyle features. The project combines luxury, privacy, and connectivity with Aravalli-facing views and large balconies.

detailsSections.heading: Key Highlights
detailsSections.text:
• Ultra-luxury 3 & 4 BHK apartments
• Prime location on Golf Course Extension Road
• Low-density project with limited units for privacy
• Massive clubhouse (60,000–1,00,000 sq.ft approx.)
• Aravalli-facing views & large balconies
• Smart home features & premium interiors
• 80% open green spaces with resort-style landscaping

Located on Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 63A Gurgaon
10–15 mins to Cyber City & Golf Course Road
